title.zh: 将莱特省Tanauan的莱特州立工艺学校更名为莱特工艺学院的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Leyte State School of Arts and Trades in Tanauan, Leyte, to Leyte College of Arts and Trades
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Leyte State School of Arts and Trades in Tanauan, Leyte, to Leyte College of Arts and Trades

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1995/ra_8011_1995.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Leyte State School of Arts and Trades in Tanauan, Leyte, is hereby changed to Leyte College of Arts and Trades.
The Leyte College of Arts and Trades shall be under the supervision of the Commission on Higher Education.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
